CustomField.description: Identifies the Contact whose verified email address was used to authorize an unauthenticated Expense Claim. This provides a trusted Salesforce identity for guest submissions while authenticated submissions can continue to use Claimant_User__c.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Populated by the Expense Claim application for verified guest submissions. Do not accept or trust this value directly from the browser.
CustomField.label: Claimant Contact
